design_notes: Use a single accent colour (e.g., #003366) for table headers, pull-quote border, and sidebar title.
Financials table: align numbers right, use parentheses for negatives, italicise 'Not separately disclosed'.
Industry snapshot: stat strip with three boxes; split bar below with proportional widths (27.5% vs 72.5%).
Pull-quote: set in larger serif italic, with a hairline rule left border in accent colour.
Sidebar: box with light background tint (e.g., #f5f5f5) and thin border.

industry_snapshot.after_paragraph: The specialty chemicals segment in India — excluding agrochemicals and dyestuff — accounted for ~17% of the Indian chemicals industry, placing it at approximately ₹1,000 billion in fiscal 2017.
industry_snapshot.rationale: Industry snapshot provides scannable context: market size, growth, and fragmentation.
industry_snapshot.split_bar_note: Small and medium enterprises hold 70–75% of the market [^drhp-p94].

pull_quotes.after_paragraph: Customer concentration is high. The top 10 customers accounted for approximately 59% of revenue in FY2015, 57% in FY2016, and 59% in FY2017.
